notes: Privileged tier measured in a VM (the root run B1b deferred). Delonix 19 ok / 31 not ok vs runc 1.5.3 53 ok / 53 not ok in the SAME root env (7 vs 24 clean-pass files) — NOT at parity, so NOT PASS. delonix oci-runtime fail-closes (DX-1000) on OCI features outside its subset — argument-filtered seccomp, ambient capabilities, process.terminal, hooks, netns-by-path, block devices, cpuset, per-container pids, RLIMIT_DATA — which the suite's default config uses, so it rejects most container launches before any behaviour. A seccomp-stripped diagnostic still scored 19/31, confirming seccomp is only the first wall. Separately the upstream suite does not support cgroup v2 (every linux_cgroups_* case fails for runc too: '# cgroupv2 is not supported yet'), capping even the reference at 24/58 — so literal 58/58 is unreachable here for any runtime. Closing the gap is engine work (grow the oci-runtime subset). Root raises the number above the rootless 15, but the full-green/parity claim is PARTIAL.
